craft_notes: Sthāyin: tree-joy (holism imaged). Cut 'of might' (L3 filler repaired). Close: tree. Rejected: 'cosmic fig' — killed: banyan kept.

lines: All-going, stainless, clear, fulfilled, self-stayed and bright —
as banyan-seed holds the great power-tree.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchas tṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ | yathā nyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ

reads_against.argmap: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — as banyan-seed tree, power-formed.
c1_essence: All-going bright tree in banyan seed, power-formed.
